a.diff:
+-- User preferences (theme, email digest) and the profile avatar URL.
+-- users.legacy_theme has not been written since the 2025 redesign.
+
+CREATE TABLE user_preferences (
+    user_id      TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+    theme        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'system',
+    email_digest TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'weekly',
+    updated_at   TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
+);
+
+CREATE INDEX user_preferences_theme_idx ON user_preferences (theme);
+
+ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN avatar_url TEXT;
+ALTER TABLE users DROP COLUMN legacy_theme;

b.diff:
+package users
+
+import (
+	"encoding/json"
+	"net/http"
+	"sync"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
+)
+
+// Preferences are a user's UI settings (table user_preferences).
+type Preferences struct {
+	UserID      string    `json:"userId"`
+	Theme       string    `json:"theme"`
+	EmailDigest string    `json:"emailDigest"`
+	UpdatedAt   time.Time `json:"updatedAt"`
+}
+
+// PreferencesStore reads and writes preferences.
+type PreferencesStore interface {
+	Get(userID string) (Preferences, error)
+	Put(p Preferences) error
+}
+
+// MemoryPreferences is an in-memory PreferencesStore for development.
+type MemoryPreferences struct {
+	mu    sync.Mutex
+	prefs map[string]Preferences
+}
+

criteria.caller update: one change updates a caller or user of what the other change defines or changes
criteria.same intent: both changes serve the same purpose or feature
criteria.same pattern: both apply the same mechanical edit (rename, signature tweak, repeated pattern)
criteria.test for: one change is a test that exercises the other change
